        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

        random_bag = data['random_bag']

        best_avg = -float('inf')

from model.base import BaseStrategy

        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

        data = message.message[0].data

        empty_bag = data['empty_bag']

        else:

            chosen_bag = sorted_candidates[0][2]

            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,

        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

        if hasattr(self._model, field_name):
            setattr(self._model, field_name, value)

    def receive_message(self, message: Info) -> Info:
        data = message.message[0].data
        random_bag = data['random_bag']
        empty_bag = data['empty_bag']
        empty_set = set(empty_bag)
        candidates = []

            coins = random_bag[idx]
            if not coins:
                continue
            avg = sum(coins)/len(coins)
            max_coin = max(coins)
            candidates.append( (avg, max_coin, idx) )
        
        if not candidates:
            chosen_bag = 0
        else:
            sorted_candidates = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1], x[2]))
            chosen_bag = sorted_candidates[0][2]
        
        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=message.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=chosen_bag, type='custom')]
        )

from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any
from enum import Enum
from abc import abstractmethod

from system.message import Info
from system.message import BaseMessageDataType
from model.strategy_type import StrategyType
from model.base import BaseStrategy

class MaxTargetCustomStrategy:
    def __init__(self, model: BaseStrategy):
        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom
    
    def update_model_field(self, field_name: str, value: Any):
        if hasattr(self._model, field_name):
            setattr(self._model, field_name, value)

    def receive_message(self, message: Info) -> Info:  
        data = message.message[0].data
        random_bag = data['random_bag']
        empty_bag = data['empty_bag']
        guess_bag = data['guess_bag']
        value_received = data['value_received']
        max_guess = data['max_guess']

        candidates = []
        for idx, coins in enumerate(random_bag):
            if idx in empty_bag:
                continue
            if not coins:
                continue
            sum_val = sum(coins)
            count = len(coins)
            exp = sum_val / count
            max_coin = max(coins)
            candidates.append( (exp, max_coin, idx) )

        if not candidates:
            # Fallback if no candidates found
            for idx in range(len(random_bag)):
                if idx not in empty_bag and random_bag[idx]:
                    chosen_bag = idx
                    break
            else:
                chosen_bag = 0  # arbitrary default
        else:
            sorted_candidates = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1]))
            chosen_bag = sorted_candidates[0][2]

        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=message.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=chosen_bag, type='custom')]
        )
